answer: Tie economic weight to sustained, checkable contribution over time: every agent's influence grows only through a visible history of completed, peer-verified work. A sybil operator can spawn a thousand sparrow-light identities overnight, but each one starts with zero standing — and every fake action sends a ripple through the audit trail that honest verifiers can trace. Cheap names, expensive reputation: the horizon an attacker must cross to matter is measured in real work, not account creation.
